scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@quiz-city/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@quiz-city/world-data && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:world-data && npm run contract:test && npm run contract:test:demo && npm test --workspace=server && node --test scripts/check-rust-toolchain.test.mjs scripts/wasm-exports.test.mjs scripts/server-coverage-reporter.test.mjs scripts/check-web-bundle.test.mjs scripts/setup-testnet-wallets.test.mjs scripts/game-assets.test.mjs functions/_api-proxy.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run contract:build && npm run build --workspace=@quiz-city/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@quiz-city/world-data && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.verify: npm run toolchain:check && npm run maps:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run secret:scan && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/check-web-bundle.mjs --skip-build && npm run contract:abi:check
scripts.chain:seed: npm run contract:build:demo && npm run contract:abi:check:demo && npm run chain:seed --workspace=server
scripts.contract:clippy: node scripts/run-contract.mjs cargo clippy --all-targets --features demo-reset -- -D warnings
scripts.contract:build: node scripts/run-contract.mjs cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm && node scripts/prepare-contract-artifact.mjs production
scripts.contract:build:demo: node scripts/run-contract.mjs cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --features demo-reset && node scripts/prepare-contract-artifact.mjs demo
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run db:test && npm run test:web && npm run test:e2e:local
scripts.maps:check: node --import tsx scripts/prepare-phase7-maps.mjs --check && node --import tsx --test scripts/prepare-phase7-maps.test.mjs
